channel.title: govbot — U.S. House: candidates on upcoming ballots
channel.description: All U.S. House races govbot is tracking on upcoming Chicago/Illinois ballots, refreshed twice daily.

item.title: U.S. Representative — IL District 1 · on the Nov 3, 2026 ballot · no candidates yet
item.description: On the ballot 2026-11-03. No candidates confirmed yet. Timeline: Primary election Mar 17, 2026 · Voter registration deadline (by mail/online) ~Oct 5, 2026 · Early voting & vote by mail underway ~Oct 19, 2026 · Election Day — general election Nov 3, 2026 · New term begins ~Jan 13, 2027. Illinois's 1st congressional district in the U.S. House. On the Nov 3, 2026 ballot for a two-year term (partisan); all 17 Illinois U.S. House seats are elected every two years.
